mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id, task_id, product_id, product_type, quantity, user_id
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL( sum( a.net_weight * c.in_production_quantity ) ,0)total_net_weight FROM mes_building_task c LEFT JOIN tech_artifact a ON a.id = c.product_id AND c.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE c.bool_delete_enum = 0 and c.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT IFNULL( SUM( te.length * bc.quantity ), 0 )/1000 FROM mes_building_complete AS bc INNER JOIN tech_enclosure AS te ON bc.product_id = te.id WHERE bc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND bc.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ENCLOSURE.getType()} AND bc.area_id IN
#{areaId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time,'%Y-%m') month,
IFNULL(sum(complete.quantity*product.net_weight), 0 )
IFNULL(sum(complete.quantity*product.length), 0 )
production FROM mes_building_complete complete
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.id=complete.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON product.id=complete.product_id
WHERE complete.task_type_enum=#{productType} AND complete.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
AND complete.factory_id=#{factoryId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time,'%Y')=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time,'%Y-%m');

SELECT project.id 'project.id', project.serial_number 'project.serial_number', project.short_name 'project.short_name', project.`name` 'project.name', IFNULL(complete.production, 0) production FROM contract_project project LEFT JOIN ( SELECT complete.project_id, sum(complete.quantity * product.net_weight) production FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.id = complete.product_id WHERE complete.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND complete.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY complete.project_id ) AS complete ON project.id = complete.project_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y') AND project.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

select.if: SELECT IFNULL(classification.classification_name,'其他') typeName, IFNULL( sum( complete.quantity * product.net_weight ), 0 ) yield FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.id = complete.product_id AND product.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification classification ON product.structure_class_id = classification.id AND classification.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND complete.task_type_enum = #{productType} AND DATE_FORMAT( complete.create_time, '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' ) GROUP BY classification.id;

SELECT product.plate typeName, IFNULL( sum( complete.quantity * product.length ), 0 ) yield FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON product.id = complete.product_id WHERE complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND complete.task_type_enum = #{productType} AND DATE_FORMAT( complete.create_time, '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' ) GROUP BY product.plate

SELECT product.plate typeName, IFNULL( sum( complete.quantity * product.length ), 0 ) yield FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON product.id = complete.product_id WHERE complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND complete.task_type_enum = #{productType} AND DATE_FORMAT( complete.create_time, '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' )
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = complete.project_id )
AND complete.project_id in
#{projectId}
GROUP BY product.plate

mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time, '%Y-%m') month, IFNULL(sum(complete.quantity * artifact.net_weight), 0) yield FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = complete.product_id WHERE complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND complete.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT complete.production_line_id id, IFNULL(sum( complete.quantity * artifact.net_weight ),0) yield FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = complete.product_id WHERE complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND complete.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND complete.in_year_month_date = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y-%m')
AND complete.production_line_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY complete.production_line_id

SELECT project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.short_name', project.serial_number 'project.serial_number', IFNULL(artifact.total_net_weight, 0) total_net_weight, IFNULL(complete.yield, 0) yield, IFNULL(despatch.despatchAmount, 0) despatchAmount FROM contract_project project LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, sum(total_net_weight) total_net_weight FROM tech_artifact WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) AS artifact ON artifact.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT complete.project_id project_id, sum(complete.quantity * artifact.net_weight) yield FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = complete.product_id WHERE complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND complete.task_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} GROUP BY complete.project_id ) AS complete ON complete.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT despatch.project_id project_id, sum(despatch.quantity * artifact.net_weight) despatchAmount FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary despatch LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = despatch.product_id WHERE despatch.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND despatch.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.task.TaskTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND despatch.type = 2 GROUP BY despatch.project_id ) AS despatch ON despatch.project_id = project.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(project.create_time, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y') AND settlement_status = 0 AND project.bool_delete_enum=0 ORDER BY project.create_time DESC

SELECT product.id,
product.`name`,
product.specification,
product.serial_number, project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.short_name', project.serial_number 'project.serial_number', date(complete.create_time) date, ifnull(sum(complete.quantity),0) quantity,
ifnull(sum(complete.quantity*product.length),0)
ifnull(sum(complete.quantity*product.net_weight),0)
mete FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON complete.project_id=project.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON complete.product_id=product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON complete.product_id=product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON complete.product_id=product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON complete.product_id=product.id
WHERE complete.task_type_enum=#{productType} AND complete.team_id=#{teamId} AND complete.in_year_month_date = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime},"%Y-%m") GROUP BY product.id,
product.`name`,
product.serial_number,
product.specification,
project.id, project.`name`, project.short_name, project.serial_number, date(complete.create_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time,"%m") month, ifnull(sum(complete.quantity),0) quantity,
ifnull(sum(complete.quantity*product.net_weight),0)
ifnull(sum(complete.quantity*product.length),0)
mete FROM mes_building_complete complete
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON complete.product_id=product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON complete.product_id=product.id
WHERE complete.task_type_enum=#{productType} AND complete.team_id=#{teamId} AND DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time,"%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime},"%Y") GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time,"%m")

SELECT IFNULL( SUM( a.mete ), 0 ) FROM ( SELECT complete.quantity * product.net_weight mete FROM mes_building_complete complete
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON complete.product_id = product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON complete.product_id = product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON complete.product_id = product.id
WHERE
DATE_FORMAT( complete.create_time, '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' )
complete.in_year_month_date = DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y-%m' )
complete.in_year_month_day_date = DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
AND complete.task_type_enum = #{taskTypeEnum} )a

SELECT
MONTH( mc.create_time) date,
DAY( mc.create_time) date,
IFNULL( sum( ta.net_weight * mc.quantity ), 0 ) totalNetWeight, IFNULL( sum( ta.gross_weight * mc.quantity ), 0 ) totalGrossWeight FROM mes_building_complete mc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON mc.product_id = ta.id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = false WHERE mc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mc.bool_delete_enum = false
AND date_format(mc.create_time, '%Y') = date_format(#{dateTime}, '%Y')
AND date_format(mc.create_time, '%Y%m') = date_format(#{dateTime}, '%Y%m')
AND mc.workshop_id = #{workShopId}
AND mc.production_line_id = #{productionLineId}
GROUP BY
MONTH( mc.create_time)
DAY( mc.create_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(bc.create_time, '%Y%m') month, SUM(bc.quantity * a.net_weight) mete FROM mes_building_complete bc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact a ON bc.product_id = a.id AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE bc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND bc.task_type_enum = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(bc.create_time, '%Y%m') >= #{startMonth} AND DATE_FORMAT(bc.create_time, '%Y%m') <= #{endMonth} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m')), 0) last_month FROM `mes_building_complete` WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m') < #{startMonth}

SELECT ifnull(a.quantity * b.net_weight,0) / 1000 as ton FROM mes_building_complete a left join tech_artifact b on a.product_id = b.id and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.task_type_enum = 2 and DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{date}, '%Y-%m' ) and a.task_id in
#{taskId}

select b.workshop_id, ( b.quantity * c.net_weight ) / 1000 as ton, date_format( b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) as dateValue from mes_building_complete b left join tech_artifact c on c.id = b.product_id and c.bool_delete_enum = 0 where b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.task_type_enum = 2 and b.workshop_id = #{id} and date_format( b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = date_format( #{date}, '%Y-%m-%d' )

select ifnull(round( sum( ( ifnull( a.quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( b.net_weight, 0 ) ) / 1000 ), 2), 0) as ton from mes_building_complete a left join tech_artifact b on a.product_id = b.id and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.task_type_enum = 2 and a.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT '构件产量' AS `key`, date_table.dates AS dateValue, ROUND( IFNULL( temp.total_weight, 0 ), 2 ) AS ton FROM ( SELECT @s := @s + 1 AS indexs,
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s YEAR ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s MONTH ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s DAY ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
FROM mysql.help_topic, ( SELECT @s := -1 ) temp WHERE @s < #{val} ORDER BY dates ) date_table LEFT JOIN ( select a.dateValue, sum( a.total_weight ) as total_weight from ( select DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, #{dimension} ) AS dateValue, ifnull( ( a.quantity * b.net_weight ) / 1000, 0 ) as total_weight from mes_building_complete a left join tech_artifact b on b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.task_type_enum = 2 ) a GROUP BY a.dateValue ) temp ON date_table.dates = temp.dateValue ORDER BY date_table.dates

SELECT '部件产量' AS `key`, date_table.dates AS dateValue, ROUND( IFNULL( temp.total_weight, 0 ), 2 ) AS ton FROM ( SELECT @s := @s + 1 AS indexs,
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s YEAR ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s MONTH ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s DAY ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
FROM mysql.help_topic, ( SELECT @s := -1 ) temp WHERE @s < #{val} ORDER BY dates ) date_table LEFT JOIN ( select a.dateValue, sum( a.total_weight ) as total_weight from ( SELECT temp.dateValue, sum( temp.total_weight ) as total_weight from ( select a.dateValue, sum( a.total_weight ) as total_weight from ( select DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) AS dateValue, ifnull( ( a.quantity * b.net_weight ) / 1000, 0 ) as total_weight from mes_building_complete a left join tech_assemble b on b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.task_type_enum = 16 ) a GROUP BY a.dateValue ) temp GROUP BY temp.dateValue ) a GROUP BY a.dateValue ) temp ON date_table.dates = temp.dateValue ORDER BY date_table.dates

SELECT '零件产量' AS `key`, date_table.dates AS dateValue, ROUND( IFNULL( temp.total_weight, 0 ), 2 ) AS ton FROM ( SELECT @s := @s + 1 AS indexs,
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s YEAR ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s MONTH ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s DAY ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
FROM mysql.help_topic, ( SELECT @s := -1 ) temp WHERE @s < #{val} ORDER BY dates ) date_table LEFT JOIN ( select a.dateValue, sum( a.total_weight ) as total_weight from ( select DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, #{dimension} ) AS dateValue, ifnull( ( a.quantity * b.net_weight ) / 1000, 0 ) as total_weight from mes_building_complete a left join tech_assemble b on b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.task_type_enum = 1 ) a GROUP BY a.dateValue ) temp ON date_table.dates = temp.dateValue ORDER BY date_table.dates

select b.process_id, b.task_quantity, b.inspection_quantity, CASE WHEN b.task_type_enum = 1 THEN ifnull( b.task_quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( c.net_weight, 0 ) WHEN b.task_type_enum = 2 THEN ifnull( b.task_quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( d.net_weight, 0 ) WHEN b.task_type_enum = 16 THEN ifnull( b.task_quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( e.net_weight, 0 ) ELSE 0 END task_ton, CASE WHEN b.task_type_enum = 1 THEN ifnull( b.inspection_quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( c.net_weight, 0 ) WHEN b.task_type_enum = 2 THEN ifnull( b.inspection_quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( d.net_weight, 0 ) WHEN b.task_type_enum = 16 THEN ifnull( b.inspection_quantity, 0 ) * ifnull( e.net_weight, 0 ) ELSE 0 END inspection_ton from mes_building_task_process b left join tech_machine_part c on c.id = b.product_id and c.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join tech_artifact d on d.id = b.product_id and d.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join tech_assemble e on e.id = b.product_id and e.bool_delete_enum = 0 where b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT cp.serial_number AS project_serial_number, cp.short_name AS short_name, cp.structure_status AS structure_status, case cp.product_category when 2 then '吨' when 4 then '米' end unit, IFNULL(ct.quantity_work / 1000, 0) AS structureQuantityWork, IFNULL(tcw.deepen_weight / (ct.quantity_work/1000) , 0) AS deepenTon, IFNULL(tpw.produced_weight / tcw.deepen_weight , 0) AS productionCompleteTon, IFNULL(tdw.delivery_weight / tcw.deepen_weight , 0) AS shippedCompleteTon FROM contract_project AS cp LEFT JOIN contract_tech ct ON ct.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ct.category_type = 2 AND ct.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.project_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS deepen_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY ta.project_id ) tcw ON tcw.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.project_id, (SUM(ta.produced_quantity * net_weight) / 1000) AS produced_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY ta.project_id ) tpw ON tpw.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbt.project_id, (SUM(mbt.task_quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS scheduling_weight FROM mes_building_task mbt LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbt.product_id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbt.task_type_enum = 2 GROUP BY mbt.project_id ) tsw ON tsw.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbws.project_id, (SUM(mbws.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS delivery_weight FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary mbws LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbws.product_id WHERE mbws.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbws.type = 2 AND mbws.product_type = 2 GROUP BY mbws.project_id ) tdw ON tdw.project_id = cp.id WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT cp.id AS project_id, cp.serial_number AS serialNumber, cp.short_name AS short_name, ROUND(IFNULL(tsw.scheduling_weight , 0),2) AS schedulingWeight FROM contract_project AS cp LEFT JOIN contract_tech ct ON ct.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ct.category_type = 2 AND ct.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbt.project_id, (SUM(mbt.task_quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS scheduling_weight FROM mes_building_task mbt LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbt.product_id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbt.task_type_enum = 2 GROUP BY mbt.project_id ) tsw on cp.id = tsw.project_id WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ta.net_weight * mc.quantity), 0) AS weeksNetWeight, w.name as workShopName FROM mes_building_complete mc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON mc.product_id = ta.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop w ON mc.workshop_id = w.id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE mc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mc.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY workShopName

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ta.net_weight * mc.quantity), 0) AS monthNetWeight, w.name AS workShopName FROM mes_building_complete mc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON mc.product_id = ta.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop w ON mc.workshop_id = w.id WHERE mc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mc.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND mc.create_time < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY workShopName;

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ta.net_weight * mc.quantity), 0) AS totalNetWeight, w.name AS workShopName FROM mes_building_complete mc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON mc.product_id = ta.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop w ON mc.workshop_id = w.id WHERE mc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND YEAR(mc.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY workShopName;

SELECT enc.*, com.quantity as actualQuantity, cp.id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', m.id 'monomer.id', m.name 'monomer.name', ar.id 'area.id', ar.name 'area.name', '0' as 'process.id', '已入库' as 'process.name' FROM mes_building_complete com INNER JOIN tech_enclosure enc ON com.product_id = enc.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = enc.project_id left join plan_monomer m on enc.monomer_id = m.id and m.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join plan_area ar on enc.area_id = ar.id and ar.bool_delete_enum = 0 where com.bool_delete_enum=0 and com.task_type_enum=4
AND com.area_id = #{areaId}
